results.recommendation: Integrate strict identity gating within the token transfer logic to block all transfers to unverified addresses until identity verification is completed. Implement role-based access controls and pre-transfer validation calls referencing an active identity registry. Add unit tests confirming that transfers to unverified addresses revert, and include event logs documenting identity validation outcomes.

prompt_instructions: Recommendations should be specific and testable (e.g. update logic, add events, monitoring, tests).
When relevant, include a brief validation plan describing what tests to add.
